reviews.review:
It's time to get thrown in the biggest mesh up of all sci-fi B movies ever made!
A 3rd person FPS so "pure" it screams fun from every direction! You will soon find yourself addicted to the action, story and camaraderie at every shout of the word EDF!
Lots of missions even with the base game to follow, an absurd number of weapons to choose from and 4 unique classes to play.
It will also feature a progression system where higher missions on higher difficulties will unlock new and deadlier equipment, each whit it's own randomised stats requiring a good deal of luck and time to unlock their full potential.

I have always been curious about this game ages ago and was very surprised to find it on steam, so much that i bought it on impulse but have not regretted it ever since.

If you don't mind a bit of retro graphics and cheese dialogues, sign up with the EDF and help save the planet from the alien invasion!

Ah,  I see you have stumbled upon one of the greatest gaming experiences money can buy.

This game IS for everybody.

For example:  My woman "sucks at games" and never played with me much. 

We just had our first child, so I insisted since we were gonna be laying around a bunch.

I brought my pc upstairs to play in 4k with her on the couch and the rest is history.

We've almost completed the base game, but im sure we will play long after that.

A very special game, perfect for anyone who likes videogames in general.

Buy it, full price.  They deserve it.

Hard to properly describe how much fun this is. 
I will say one thing, the upgrades and enhancements made in this title over the previous are numerous, and very welcomed!
I greatly appreciate and enjoy all the new features and things. 

Whether playing solo or with friends, each map has countless approaches. There are heaps of tactics you can employ to surpass the levels, and sometimes I try to find the most off-the-wall zany way to win.

Great game. Great fun. Defend our Mother Earth from any alien attack!

4 classes each with a massive, upgradable arsenal of weapons and gear. Over 100 missions and good times both solo and co-op online. Blast them giant bugs and aliens good!

If you like the exact same game (4.1) but a little different, buy it! Otherwise, bad balancing, same maps, levels, with a slightly different twist. Fun with friends but doesn't last long as the mechanics are meh.
